profiles.display_name: Experimental Level I equilibrium fugacity screening
equation_text: solid capacity terms use Z_water * Kd * mass_kg with governed organic-carbon fractions
required_inputs: air/water capacity volumes and soil/sediment capacity masses

source_references.title: CEMC Evaluative Level I, II, III Fugacity Models
CEMC Level III Fugacity Model boundary description
OECD Pov and LRTP Screening Tool

limitations: Experimental Level I screening assumes equilibrium partitioning across all four active media.
Release entry medium affects scoped mass only; it does not route mass between compartments.
Uses scenario temperature in R*T but does not apply Henry-law temperature correction in the current experimental fugacity screening kernel.
Not Level III, not intermedia-transfer kinetics, not GIS routing, not calibration, not field validation, and not regulator acceptance.
profiles.applicability_note: Use only as an experimental non-default partitioning challenge path against the reference mass-balance baseline.

profiles.display_name: Experimental Level II equilibrium persistence fugacity screening
required_inputs: air/water capacity volumes and soil/sediment capacity masses

source_references.title: CEMC Evaluative Level I, II, III Fugacity Models
CEMC Level III Fugacity Model boundary description
OECD Pov and LRTP Screening Tool

limitations: Experimental Level II screening adds first-order degradation losses while preserving equilibrium partitioning.
Does not include Level III non-equilibrium transfer, advective export, deposition, hydrology, routing, calibration, field validation, or regulator acceptance.
Degradation half-lives are scalar screening inputs and do not represent pathway-specific transformation chemistry.
deferred_capabilities: Level III transfer coefficients and advective loss between media
spatial routing or calibrated multimedia fate simulation
profiles.applicability_note: Use as an experimental persistence/partitioning challenge path when degradation-loss balance matters but Level III transfer is out of scope.

source_references.title: CEMC Evaluative Level I, II, III Fugacity Models
CEMC Level III Fugacity Model boundary description
OECD Pov and LRTP Screening Tool

limitations: Fugacity profiles are experimental Level I/II screening descriptions only.
No Level III, hydrology, routing, calibration, field-validation, WEPP/SWAT/PRZM execution, exposure, risk, or regulator acceptance claim is implied.
